searchText: question for other client teams, do you use any beacon API endpoint to help track some metric on the validators that are connected to a beacon node? that's not a well-defined quantity exactly. there are certain things one can infer, e.g., related to sync committees or attestation subnets which need to be subscribed to, but it's an intrinsically vague metric because there's not typically a single continuous connection, and they can sort of silently fade away right having some kind of expiration 😅 some setups have multiple vcs connected to their beacon node I guess having some metric on how many validators from those vcs especially if the service runs the bn stand alone might be useful not sure if other clients got similar requests Ok, well, Nimbus hasn't we have validator monitoring which tracks the performance of connected validators on the the beacon node side, we don't expose this data tthrough the api, only via metrics and have a dashboard for it right just through metrics, how does it get tracked? just a cache tied to some endpoint ( for us we are thinking about the proposer settings api to update this) we register validators for monitoring based on `prepareBeaconCommitteeSubnet` and `prepareSyncCommitteeSubnets`
